Sales Invoices — Discount

The Fix Discounts utility corrects rounding issues that can occur when using percentage-based discounts on sales invoices.

When applying percentage discounts, small rounding differences can accumulate and cause discrepancies in invoice totals. This utility identifies these discrepancies and converts the percentage discounts to exact amount discounts that preserve the intended final values.

This ensures that your invoice calculations remain accurate and consistent, especially when dealing with multiple line items or currencies with different decimal place requirements.

The utility will automatically scan all sales invoices with percentage discounts and convert them to exact amounts where rounding issues are detected.
